flags.title: Sector tailwind
flags.note: Chemicals is in a TAILWIND (tailwind score +0.76) — the macro backdrop supports the setup.
flags.lesson: Focus on cycles and change, not insider chatter (the author's actual edge).

strengths.point: ROCE runs well ahead of the sector median.
ROE runs well ahead of the sector median.
Promoters hold a controlling majority - skin in the game.
Chemicals is in a tailwind - the macro backdrop is supportive.

weaknesses.point: The share price has run ahead of the fundamentals.
P/B is expensive against the sector median.
Institutional money has been flowing out.
weaknesses.evidence: NEGATIVE MONEY FLOW - institutional holding change -0.13 pp

weaknesses.point: Foreign institutions have been cutting their stake.
Domestic institutions have been cutting their stake.

opportunities.point: Sacheerome expects to remain well positioned to capitalize on emerging opportunities and sustain long-term profitable growth.
opportunities.evidence: Management guidance: "With our strengthened balance sheet, healthy cash flows, and scalable operating platform, we remain well positioned to capitalize on emerging opportunities and sustain long -term profitable growth." (concall ppt - 2026-06-01)

opportunities.point: The company hopes to perform as well as the first half or slightly better in the full year FY26.
opportunities.evidence: Management guidance: "We are at the end of the second month of the third quarter. Okay? So, we are doing equally good and we hope to perform as good as the first half or even a little better." (concall transcript - 2025-12-01)

opportunities.point: Civil construction of the upcoming facility at Yamuna Express Industrial Development Area is nearly complete.
opportunities.evidence: Capex / expansion plan: "As the first half of FY26, we have nearly completed the civil construction of our upcoming facility at Yamuna Express Industrial Development Area." (concall transcript - 2025-12-01)

opportunities.point: The new facility is expected to be fully operational in Q4 of FY26.
opportunities.evidence: Capex / expansion plan: "We remain on track to bring the new facility in full operations in Q4 of FY26." (concall transcript - 2025-12-01)

opportunities.point: A chemicals tailwind can lift earnings without the company doing anything different.
The fragrance and flavour industry is witnessing strong demand driven by FMCG, food & beverage, and personal care categories.
opportunities.evidence: Demand outlook: "The fragrance and flavour industry continues to witness strong demand supported by growing consumption across FMCG, food & beverage, and personal care categories." (concall ppt - 2026-06-01)

opportunities.point: The company experienced strong performance driven by healthy demand across different product categories.
opportunities.evidence: Demand outlook: "We delivered a strong performance, driven by healthy demand across different product categories, and with the enhanced product range." (concall transcript - 2025-12-01)

opportunities.point: The company's current capacity is 7,60,000 kilos, and the new capacity will add another 20 lakh kilos.
opportunities.evidence: Orders / capacity: "So, as you are aware, our current capacity is 7,60,000 kilos and in the new capacity, we are doing adding another 20 lakh kilos which will make our total capacity to 27,60,000 kilos." (concall transcript - 2025-12-01)

opportunities.point: The new capacity will be almost five times the current capacity.
opportunities.evidence: Orders / capacity: "And our new capacity will have 5x (almost) than the current capacity." (concall transcript - 2025-12-01)

opportunities.point: The company is on track to bring the new facility into full operations in Q4 of FY26.
opportunities.evidence: Management commitment: "We remain on track to bring the new facility in full operations in Q4 of FY26." (concall transcript - 2025-12-01) [H2 FY26]

opportunities.point: Revenue will start coming from the new facility from the first quarter of the next financial year.
opportunities.evidence: Management commitment: "From the first quarter of the next financial year, the revenue will start coming from the new facility also." (concall transcript - 2025-12-01) [FY27]

opportunities.point: The company expects almost more than 100% capacity utilization in FY27.

threats.point: Both foreign and domestic institutions have been reducing.
threats.evidence: FII -1.27 pp, DII -6.54 pp over the recent quarters

threats.point: A price that has outrun earnings needs the growth to catch up or it de-rates.
Company performance could be impacted by macroeconomic trends, regulatory shifts, foreign exchange rate fluctuations, interest rate movements, and competitive pressures.
threats.evidence: Risk disclosed in the filings: "These factors include, but are not limited to, general market, macro economic, governmental and regulatory trends, movements in currency exchange and interest rates, competitive pressures, technological developments, changes in the financial conditions of..." (concall ppt - 2026-06-01)

threats.point: The industry has faced turbulences such as a fire in BSF, COVID, China products, and scarcity due to climatic conditions.
threats.evidence: Risk disclosed in the filings: "There are three turbulences we have faced, everybody in the industry, not only we. First of all, there was a fire in BSF, then there was COVID, then, China products, and sometimes, due to the climatic conditions, due to some reasons, there is scarcity." (concall transcript - 2025-12-01)

threats.point: Some competitive pressures exist in the market.
threats.evidence: Risk disclosed in the filings: "While some competitive pressures exist, our value-added offerings and differentiated solutions allow us to maintain the healthy margins." (concall transcript - 2025-12-01)

swot.verdict: Opportunities dominate the evidence (S8/W12/O28/T10), led by 'Sacheerome expects to remain well positioned to capitalize on emerging opportunities and sustain long-term profitable growth', so the case leans on things that are not in the reported numbers yet.
